issues.legal_issue: The limitation period for seeking re-determination of compensation on the basis of an award in another landowner’s reference begins on the date the court pronounced that award, not on the date the applicant learned of it.
material_facts: Land was acquired under a common notification, and a court enhanced compensation in a reference brought by other landowners.
The applicants, who had not sought a reference, applied for re-determination about five years after the court’s award.
The High Court held that the limitation period began when the applicants learned of the award and directed that their applications be entertained.
issues.conclusion: The period begins on the date the court pronounced the award. In computing it, the day of pronouncement and the time required to obtain a copy of the award are excluded; lack of knowledge does not extend the period. The appeals were allowed and the High Court’s order was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Section 28-A(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, and its proviso expressly measure the three-month period from the court’s award and exclude the day of pronouncement and the time requisite to obtain a copy. Tola Ram v. State of U.P., Union of India v. Mangatu Ram, and Jose Antonio Cruz Dos R. Rodriguese v. Land Acquisition Collector hold that knowledge does not alter that starting point. Raja Harish Chandra Raj Singh v. Deputy Land Acquisition Officer, approved in State of Punjab v. Mst. Qaisar Jehan Begum, concerned Section 18 and was distinguished: that provision’s notice-related scheme does not govern an application by a person who was not party to the reference. The beneficial nature of the provision does not excuse failure to act within its prescribed period.

predicates.redetermination_application_based_on_ano: An applicant sought re-determination of compensation by relying on an award obtained in another landowner’s court reference.
predicates.acquisition_under_same_notification: The applicant’s land and the land in the reference were acquired under the same notification.
predicates.court_award_increased_compensation: A court awarded greater compensation than the original acquisition award.

issues.definition: When an applicant seeks re-determination based on an increased award in another landowner’s reference for land acquired under the same notification, the filing period runs from the court’s award, subject to excluding the time required to obtain a copy.
